Columns are ambiguous: table has two $/SF-like columns before percentages and two tax/carrying-charge columns after common charges; interpreted first $ column after Int SF as price-per-SF (not price), second $ block as common charges, third as taxes, fourth as monthly carrying charges, consistent with header pattern seen on similar Schedule A pages, but headers themselves were not visible on this page image (only data rows), so column identification for int_sf/ext_sf/pct/pct2/cc/tax/carry is based on position/pattern inference, not confirmed labels.
Price column values shown (e.g., 1,380,000.00) assumed to be "price" though positioned under what could be a $/SF-adjacent column; confirmed by matching magnitude to typical unit prices.
